title: Self-signed code signing for local builds
acceptance: A code-signing certificate can be generated locally, trusted for the current user, and used by scripts/package.ps1 to sign pdfxi.exe, pdfxi-ui.exe and the setup; every signature verifies; missing thumbprint leaves the build unsigned and records that state; T-0202 documents the self-signed scope and limits; evidence recorded.
notes: Stream B of the post-0.1.4 close-out. Free local certificate only; not a publicly trusted publisher.
